title.ur: Mukaalma 1: Aap kya kaam karte hain?

intro.en: Two men talk about their jobs: where they work, how many hours a day, and whether they love their work.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein do aadmi apne kaam ke baare mein baat karte hain: kahan kaam karte hain, din mein kitne ghante, aur kya unhein apna kaam pasand hai.
intro.ar: يَتَحَدَّثُ رَجُلانِ عَنْ عَمَلِهِما: أَيْنَ يَعْمَلان، وَكَمْ ساعَةً في اليَوْم، وَهَلْ يُحِبّانِ عَمَلَهُما.

dialogue.en: I work as a doctor. What do you do?
dialogue.ur: Main doctor hoon. Aap kya kaam karte hain?

dialogue.en: I work as an engineer.
dialogue.ur: Main engineer hoon.

dialogue.en: Where do you work?
dialogue.ur: Aap kahan kaam karte hain?

dialogue.ar: أَعْمَلُ في شَرِكَة، أَيْنَ تَعْمَلُ أَنْتَ؟
dialogue.tr: aʿmalu fī sharika, ayna taʿmalu anta?
dialogue.en: I work in a company. Where do you work?
dialogue.ur: Main ek company mein kaam karta hoon. Aap kahan kaam karte hain?

dialogue.en: I work in the hospital.
dialogue.ur: Main hospital mein kaam karta hoon.

dialogue.en: How many hours do you work a day?
dialogue.ur: Aap din mein kitne ghante kaam karte hain?

dialogue.en: I work eight hours a day.
dialogue.ur: Main din mein aath ghante kaam karta hoon.

dialogue.en: I work seven hours.
dialogue.ur: Main saat ghante kaam karta hoon.

dialogue.en: Do you love your work?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap ko apna kaam pasand hai?

dialogue.en: Yes, I love my work.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, mujhe apna kaam pasand hai.

dialogue.en: I love my work too.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe bhi apna kaam pasand hai.

q.en: How many hours a day does Ali work?
q.ur: Ali din mein kitne ghante kaam karta hai?
q.ar: كَمْ ساعَةً يَعْمَلُ عَلِيٌّ في اليَوْم؟

q.en: How do you say "Do you love your work?"
q.ur: "Kya aap apne kaam se mohabbat karte hain?" Arabic mein kaise kahenge?
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ نَسْأَلُ بِهِ عَنْ حُبِّ العَمَل؟

intro.en: Students say what they study at college and what they will be, in shā' Allāh. Notice سَأَعْمَلُ – "I will work".
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein talib-e-ilm bataate hain ke woh college mein kya parhte hain aur parhai ke baad kya banenge, in shā' Allāh. Dhyan dein: سَأَعْمَلُ ka matlab hai "main kaam karunga".
intro.ar: يَقولُ الطُّلّابُ ماذا يَدْرُسونَ في الكُلِّيَّةِ وَماذا سَيَكونونَ إِنْ شاءَ الله. نَتَعَلَّمُ كَلِمَةَ «سَأَعْمَلُ» لِلْمُسْتَقْبَل.

dialogue.en: What will you do after studying?
dialogue.ur: Parhai ke baad aap kya karenge?

dialogue.ar: أَنا أَدْرُسُ الطِّبَّ في كُلِّيَّةِ الطِّبِّ، سَأَعْمَلُ طَبيباً، إِنْ شاءَ الله.
dialogue.tr: anā adrusu ṭ-ṭibba fī kulliyyati ṭ-ṭibb, sa-aʿmalu ṭabīban, in shāʾa llāh
dialogue.en: I study medicine at the College of Medicine; I will work as a doctor, if Allah wills.
dialogue.ur: Main medical college mein tibb parhta hoon, main doctor banunga, in shā' Allāh.

dialogue.ar: أَنا أَدْرُسُ الصَّيْدَلَةَ في كُلِّيَّةِ الصَّيْدَلَة، سَأَعْمَلُ صَيْدَلِيّاً، إِنْ شاءَ الله.
dialogue.tr: anā adrusu ṣ-ṣaydala fī kulliyyati ṣ-ṣaydala, sa-aʿmalu ṣaydaliyyan, in shāʾa llāh
dialogue.en: I study pharmacy; I will work as a pharmacist, if Allah wills.
dialogue.ur: Main pharmacy parhta hoon, main pharmacist banunga, in shā' Allāh.

dialogue.ar: أَنا أَدْرُسُ التَّمْريضَ في كُلِّيَّةِ التَّمْريض، سَأَعْمَلُ مُمَرِّضاً، إِنْ شاءَ الله.
dialogue.tr: anā adrusu t-tamrīḍa fī kulliyyati t-tamrīḍ, sa-aʿmalu mumarriḍan, in shāʾa llāh
dialogue.en: I study nursing; I will work as a nurse, if Allah wills.
dialogue.ur: Main nursing parhta hoon, main nurse banunga, in shā' Allāh.

dialogue.ar: أَنا أَدْرُسُ الهَنْدَسَةَ في كُلِّيَّةِ الهَنْدَسَة، سَأَعْمَلُ مُهَنْدِساً، إِنْ شاءَ الله.
dialogue.tr: anā adrusu l-handasa fī kulliyyati l-handasa, sa-aʿmalu muhandisan, in shāʾa llāh
dialogue.en: I study engineering; I will work as an engineer, if Allah wills.
dialogue.ur: Main engineering parhta hoon, main engineer banunga, in shā' Allāh.

dialogue.ar: أَنا أَدْرُسُ الطَّيَرانَ في كُلِّيَّةِ الطَّيَران، سَأَعْمَلُ طَيّاراً، إِنْ شاءَ الله.
dialogue.tr: anā adrusu ṭ-ṭayarāna fī kulliyyati ṭ-ṭayarān, sa-aʿmalu ṭayyāran, in shāʾa llāh
dialogue.en: I study aviation; I will work as a pilot, if Allah wills.
dialogue.ur: Main aviation parhta hoon, main pilot banunga, in shā' Allāh.

dialogue.ar: أَنا أَدْرُسُ التَّرْبِيَةَ في كُلِّيَّةِ التَّرْبِيَة، سَأَعْمَلُ مُدَرِّساً، إِنْ شاءَ الله.
dialogue.tr: anā adrusu t-tarbiya fī kulliyyati t-tarbiya, sa-aʿmalu mudarrisan, in shāʾa llāh
dialogue.en: I study education; I will work as a teacher, if Allah wills.
dialogue.ur: Main education parhta hoon, main ustaad banunga, in shā' Allāh.

q.en: Who will work as a nurse?
q.ur: Kaun nurse ban kar kaam karega?
Kaun sa college udaan (flying) ke liye hai?

q.en: What do we add at the end to say "if Allah wills"?
q.ur: "Agar Allah ne chaha" kehne ke liye aakhir mein kya kehte hain?
q.ar: ماذا نَقولُ لِنَعْنِيَ أَنَّ الأَمْرَ بِمَشيئَةِ الله؟

intro.en: Maryam and Zaynab are teachers. They talk about their job, school stage and children.
intro.ur: Maryam aur Zainab dono ustaaniyan hain. Woh apne pesha, school ki jamaat (stage) aur bachon ke baare mein baat karti hain.
intro.ar: مَرْيَمُ وَزَيْنَبُ مُدَرِّسَتان. تَتَحَدَّثانِ عَنْ مِهْنَتِهِما وَالمَرْحَلَةِ الدِّراسِيَّةِ وَالأَطْفال.

dialogue.en: I am a teacher. What is your profession?
dialogue.ur: Main ustaani hoon. Aap ka pesha kya hai?

dialogue.en: I am a teacher too.
dialogue.ur: Main bhi ustaani hoon.

dialogue.en: Which stage do you teach?
dialogue.ur: Aap kis marhale mein parhati hain?

dialogue.ar: أُدَرِّسُ في المَرْحَلَةِ الابْتِدائِيَّة. وَفي أَيِّ مَرْحَلَةٍ تُدَرِّسينَ أَنْتِ؟
dialogue.tr: udarrisu fī l-marḥalati l-ibtidāʾiyya. wa fī ayyi marḥalatin tudarrisīna anti?
dialogue.en: I teach in the primary stage. And which stage do you teach?
dialogue.ur: Main ibtidai marhale mein parhati hoon. Aur aap kis marhale mein parhati hain?

dialogue.en: I teach in the intermediate stage.
dialogue.ur: Main mutawassit marhale mein parhati hoon.

dialogue.en: Do you have children?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap ke bachay hain?

dialogue.en: Yes, I have children.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, mere bachay hain.

dialogue.en: How many children do you have?
dialogue.ur: Aap ke kitne bachay hain?

dialogue.en: I have five children.
dialogue.ur: Mere paanch bachay hain.

dialogue.en: Do you love your work?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap ko apna kaam pasand hai?

dialogue.en: Yes, I love my work.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, mujhe apna kaam pasand hai.

dialogue.en: And I love my work too.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe bhi apna kaam pasand hai.

q.en: How many children does Maryam have?

options_ar: العَمَلُ الذي يَكْسِبُ مِنْهُ الإِنْسانُ رِزْقَه

q.ur: Zainab kis marhale (stage) mein parhati hai?

intro.en: Match people to their colleges, and learn the hours of the clock: الواحِدَة (one o'clock) up to الثّانِيَةَ عَشْرَة (twelve).
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum logon ko unke colleges se milate hain aur ghadi ke ghantay seekhte hain: الواحِدَة (ek baje) se الثّانِيَةَ عَشْرَة (barah baje) tak.
intro.ar: نَرْبِطُ الأَشْخاصَ بِكُلِّيّاتِهِم، وَنَتَعَلَّمُ ساعاتِ الوَقْتِ مِنَ الواحِدَةِ إِلى الثّانِيَةَ عَشْرَة.

q.ur: Kaun sa lafz "ghadi / ghanta" ko kehte hain?
Kaun sa college ustaad taiyar karta hai?

title.ur: Jumlon ke andaaz: ghantay aur bachay

intro.en: Practise questions and answers: how many hours do you work, how many children do you have, and ordering words into sentences.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein sawal jawab ki mashq hai: aap kitne ghante kaam karte hain, aap ke kitne bachay hain, aur lafzon ko tarteeb dena.
intro.ar: نَتَدَرَّبُ على الأَسْئِلَةِ وَالأَجْوِبَة: كَمْ ساعَةً تَعْمَل؟ كَمْ طِفْلاً لَك؟ وَنُرَتِّبُ الكَلِماتِ لِنُكَوِّنَ جُمَلاً.

q.en: How do you ask "How many hours do you work a day?"
q.ur: "Aap din mein kitne ghante kaam karte hain?" kaise poochte hain?
q.ar: اِخْتَرِ السُّؤالَ عَنْ عَدَدِ ساعاتِ العَمَلِ في اليَوْم.
اِخْتَرِ الجَوابَ لِمَنْ لَهُ خَمْسَةُ أَطْفال.

q.en: Put in order: "I study engineering at the College of Engineering"
q.ur: Tarteeb dein: "Main engineering college mein engineering parhta hoon"
q.ar: رَتِّبِ الكَلِماتِ لِتُكَوِّنَ جُمْلَةً صَحيحَةً عَنْ دِراسَةِ الهَنْدَسَة.

intro.en: Listen and repeat words with the heavy letter ض (ḍād), like رَمَضان, مُمَرِّض and أَيْضاً. Then hear it in verses of the Qur'an.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein harf ض (zaad) wale lafz sunein aur dohraein, jaise رَمَضان، مُمَرِّض aur أَيْضاً. Phir Quran ki aayaat mein isay sunein.
intro.ar: نَسْتَمِعُ وَنُكَرِّرُ كَلِماتٍ فيها حَرْفُ الضّادِ المُفَخَّم، مِثْلَ رَمَضان وَمُمَرِّض وَأَيْضاً، ثُمَّ نَسْمَعُهُ في آياتٍ مِنَ القُرْآن.

q.en: Which letter is taught in this lesson?
q.ur: Is sabaq mein kaun sa harf sikhaya gaya hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ حَرْفٍ نَتَعَلَّمُهُ في هذا الدَّرْس؟

options_ar: امْرَأَةٌ تَفْحَصُ المَرْضى وَتَكْتُبُ لَهُمُ الدَّواء

intro.en: Practise talking with a partner: ask about working hours, where someone studies, and what they will do after studying.
intro.ur: Apne saathi ke saath baat karne ki mashq: kaam ke ghantay, kahan parhte hain, aur parhai ke baad kya karenge.
intro.ar: نَتَحَدَّثُ مَعَ زَميلٍ فَنَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ ساعاتِ العَمَلِ وَمَكانِ الدِّراسَةِ وَماذا سَيَعْمَلُ بَعْدَ الدِّراسَة.

vocab.en: How many hours do you work?
vocab.ur: Aap kitne ghante kaam karte hain?

q.en: Answer: "I study at the College of Medicine."
q.ur: Jawab: "Main medical college mein parhta hoon."

q.en: Ask: "What will you do after studying?"
q.ur: Poochein: "Parhai ke baad aap kya karenge?"
q.ar: اِخْتَرِ السُّؤالَ عَمّا سَيَعْمَلُهُ المَرْءُ بَعْدَ الدِّراسَة.

q.en: Answer: "I will work as a doctor, if Allah wills."
q.ur: Jawab: "Main doctor banunga, in shā' Allāh."
q.ar: اِخْتَرِ الجَوابَ لِمَنْ يُريدُ أَنْ يَكونَ طَبيباً إِنْ شاءَ الله.

intro.en: Read a short passage about Omar, a pilot, and answer questions about his work, hours and days off.
intro.ur: Umar pilot ke baare mein ek chhota paragraph parhein aur uske kaam, ghanton aur chhutti ke baare mein sawalon ke jawab dein.
intro.ar: نَقْرَأُ فِقْرَةً قَصيرَةً عَنْ عُمَر، وَهُوَ طَيّار، وَنُجيبُ عَنْ عَمَلِهِ وَساعاتِهِ وَأَيّامِ إِجازَتِه.

q.en: How many hours a day does Omar work?
q.ur: Umar din mein kitne ghante kaam karta hai?
q.ar: كَمْ ساعَةً يَعْمَلُ عُمَرُ في اليَوْم؟

q.en: How many days a week does he work?
q.ur: Woh hafte mein kitne din kaam karta hai?

q.en: On which days is his holiday?
q.ur: Uski chhutti kin dinon mein hoti hai?

q.en: How does Omar go to the company?

intro.en: Join letters to make words, put scrambled letters in order, and write short sentences about jobs and colleges.
intro.ur: Haroof ko jod kar lafz banayein, bikhre hue haroof ki tarteeb theek karein, aur pesha aur colleges ke baare mein chhote jumle likhein.
intro.ar: نَصِلُ الحُروفَ لِنُكَوِّنَ كَلِمات، وَنُرَتِّبُ الحُروفَ المُبَعْثَرَة، وَنَكْتُبُ جُمَلاً قَصيرَةً عَنِ المِهَنِ وَالكُلِّيّات.

q.en: Join the letters ط + ف + ل to make a word.
q.ur: ط + ف + ل ko jod kar lafz banayein.
q.ar: صِلِ الحُروفَ ط + ف + ل لِتَكْتُبَ كَلِمَة.

q.en: Which word is a place of work?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz kaam ki jagah hai?

q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني مَنْ يُجَهِّزُ الدَّواء؟

options_ar: ما نَأْكُلُهُ في الصَّباحِ وَالظُّهْرِ وَاللَّيْل

intro.en: A review of jobs, colleges, hours, children and the letter ض from this unit and the last.
intro.ur: Is unit aur pichhle unit ke pesha, colleges, ghantay, bachon aur harf ض ka dohrao.
intro.ar: مُراجَعَةٌ لِلْمِهَنِ وَالكُلِّيّاتِ وَالسّاعاتِ وَالأَطْفالِ وَحَرْفِ الضّادِ مِنْ هذِهِ الوَحْدَةِ وَالَّتي قَبْلَها.

q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني مَنْ يَعْمَلُ في الهَنْدَسَة؟

q.ur: Kaun sa college pharmacy sikhata hai?
"Mujhe apna kaam pasand hai" kaise kahenge?
q.ar: اِخْتَرِ الجُمْلَةَ التي يَقولُ بِها المَرْءُ إِنَّهُ يُحِبُّ عَمَلَه.

options_ar: رَجُلٌ يَفْحَصُ المَرْضى وَيَكْتُبُ لَهُمُ الدَّواء
